purpose: Small, reproducible real-data ingestion into a separate pilot database, to validate TraitBank against real EOL TraitBank rows and real literature before any production use.
approval_required_for: fetching any source marked approved_for_fetch (network download)
creating and writing the separate pilot database
loading a canonical taxonomy subset into the pilot database (a read-only export of public.orchid_taxonomy, or a named genus subset)
never_in_scope: production database or Knowledge Graph writes
committing downloaded data to any repository

sources.description: EOL 'All trait data' archive (pages.csv, traits.csv, metadata.csv, inferred.csv, terms.csv).
sources.reported_size: about 592 MB according to the record description seen in a web search result; not verified from this environment (zenodo.org does not resolve here)
sources.license: unverified: read from the Zenodo record and confirm before approval
sources.citation: Encyclopedia of Life. All trait data. Zenodo record 13305577 (version and DOI to be confirmed from the record before approval).
sources.concern: Exceeds a 'small' pilot. The archive must be downloaded whole even though only Orchidaceae rows are kept. Approve only if a smaller per-resource or per-taxon export cannot be obtained.

sources.description: Darwin (1862), Angraecum sesquipedale nectary statement, already in the repository as a PaperKnowledge fixture (public domain, verbatim excerpt). Needs no download.
sources.citation: Charles Darwin (1862). On the Various Contrivances by which British and Foreign Orchids are Fertilised by Insects. John Murray.
